Name: PC's Kawaii Truffle Foxes for Alternative Textures
Author: Kazan22
Description:
I absolutely love using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12735]PC's Kawaii Truffle Foxes[/url] but I wanted to also be able to have pigs so (with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/147754183]PlatinumCats[/url]) I converted it to an Alternative Texture pack!

[size=5][size=5]How to install
[/size]
[list=1]

1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿
3. Download the .zip file(s) and extract into your /Mods folder or download using Vortex.[/list][size=5]
How to use[/size]

[size=3]Recolour your buildings using the Scissors from the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] [size=3]mod.[/size]

Disclaimer/Bugs/Issues
[/size]
This does not replace the pig sounds
